label: Close every catalog-read breach found across five adversarial rounds
author: supervisor-inline
note: 3 of 5 rounds found a defect created by the previous round's fix, 2 of them mine. Structural outcomes: boot-time route-coverage assertion, fail-closed tenancy, guest identity as a positive credential, requireUserId for nullable Actor.userId. Two self-inflicted defects closed here too: order line-item validation read through the caller-facing catalog path so no operator without catalog:update could sell a draft product; API keys with no operator and no reference carried userId "", a shared literal that satisfied assertOwnership against itself. Layaway diagnosis was wrong for a full session because plugin tests resolve @porulle/core/testing to dist and src instrumentation never ran

label: Declare every better-auth 1.7 column and fix the parity guard that missed them
author: supervisor-inline
note: account.issuer was already fixed; jwks.alg was not. Root cause was the guard itself: AUTH_SCHEMA_GUARD_OPTIONS passed plugins:[] under a comment claiming it mirrored createAuth, and GUARDED_MODELS was a hand-written list of the same four tables already repaired. Rewritten to pass the maximal plugin set and walk every model getAuthTables reports. Red gate produced exactly 6 mismatches: jwks.alg, jwks.crv, user.twoFactorEnabled, user.phoneNumber, user.phoneNumberVerified, twoFactor table. Also corrected an overstated fail-closed claim in the security changeset: a configured defaultOrganizationId still answers before strict resolution throws

label: Make check-types green: vitest config rootDir and nullable-userId fallout
author: supervisor-inline
note: Two of my own commits had left this gate red. d63f05a made every vitest.config.ts import a repo-root module while 41 tsconfigs include that file under a package rootDir (TS6059 in ~30 packages); I ran build and tests before pushing and skipped check-types. 27de203 had already broken 4 packages via nullable Actor.userId in test files and store-example, which tsconfig.build.json excludes so the build stayed green. Also completed the fork-cap fix: d63f05a capped vitest but left turbo build uncapped at its default concurrency of 10, which drove load average to 52 on 8 cores
